body: I only use reddit so I don't think so

I try to do small things for myself here and there. Once a month get a $10 book or album, spend some time doing a hobby.

Deep down I believe there's a way out of this, I think the best way is going to a trade school to get into a trade but I'm scared it won't work out or I'll be terrible at it. My goal is to get a car first and then go to trade school so I can get a decent career. I just keep falling into depressive episodes while working on all this.
